decisions.reason: The 15-day express program costs little to keep and its demand is still uncertain, though it overlaps with the other express programs and may be folded into them.
The 72-hour express option is still an open, low-cost option whose value is unresolved, but it is only mentioned on the website and is redundant with D, so consolidation is a real risk.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core modular fire-door system and was featured prominently, so it has strong prospects and a low marginal cost.
The umbrella express delivery program has its own page and is likely the surviving vehicle for fast-delivery offers while the value of the option is still being learned.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports trade partners and service strategy, and its value is still unfolding, so keeping the option is worthwhile.
The fire and smoke protection door sits within the established certified product range, where carrying cost is minimal and compliance-driven demand is stable.
